Rajput, NTPC Shri Nishant Gupta, NTPC _Interim Order in Petition No.36/RP/2016 (in Petition No.270/GT/2014)_ _Page 1 of 2_ # ** Interim Order ** This application has been made by the petitioner, NTPC, for review of order dated 27.6.2016 in Petition No. 270/GT/2014, whereby the Commission had determined the tariff of Simhadri Super Thermal Power Station, (1000 MW) for the period from 1.4.2014 to 31.3.2019 in terms of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2014. 2. Aggrieved by the said order dated 27.6.2016, the representative of the petitioner submitted that there are certain errors apparent on the face of the order and sought review on the issue of disallowance of expenditure of `280.00 lakh incurred towards augmentation of fire fighting system 3. Heard the representative of the petitioner on 'admission'. Admit and issue notice to the respondents. 4. The petitioner is directed to serve the copy of the review petition along with this order on the respondents by 10.9.2016. The respondents shall file their replies by 18.9.2016, with copy to the petitioner, who shall file its rejoinder, if any, by 26.9.2016. The parties shall ensure the completion of the pleadings within the due date mentioned and no extension of time shall be granted for any reason whatsoever 5.
